name: Ultimate Performance power plan
desc: Activates the hidden Ultimate Performance plan: no CPU throttling, minimal latency. Desktops only; raises power draw.

name: Faster UI: minimize animations and menu delay
desc: Removes window minimize/maximize animation, taskbar animation and the menu hover delay. Snappier feel, zero risk.

name: Visual effects: best performance preset
desc: Windows "Adjust for best performance" visual-effects mask. Flatter look; applies fully after sign-out.

name: Disable transparency effects
desc: Turns off acrylic/mica transparency. Saves GPU work, especially on integrated graphics.

name: Faster shutdown and hung-app handling
desc: Shortens the time Windows waits for stuck services and apps before ending them (5s / 3s instead of 20s / 5s).

name: Remove startup app delay
desc: Windows delays startup apps by ~10s after sign-in. This starts them immediately.

name: Prioritize foreground apps
desc: Win32PrioritySeparation = 0x26: short, fixed quanta with strong foreground boost. Better responsiveness for the app in front.

name: Disable CPU power throttling
desc: Stops Windows from throttling background-process CPU speed. Useful on desktops; costs battery on laptops.

name: Disable Fast Startup
desc: Fast Startup is a hybrid hibernate that keeps stale driver state. Disabling gives true clean boots and fixes many odd issues.

name: Disable hibernation (frees disk space)
desc: Deletes hiberfil.sys (about 40% of RAM size). Do not use if you rely on hibernate.
apply_text: powercfg /hibernate off | Out-Null; $null

name: NTFS: stop last-access timestamp writes
desc: Avoids a disk write for every file read. Reduces I/O and SSD wear.
apply_text: $o = Invoke-Native fsutil @('behavior', 'query', 'disablelastaccess'); $prev = if ($o -match '=\s*(\d)') { [int]$Matches[1] } else { 2 }; fsutil behavior set disablelastaccess 1 | Out-Null; @{ Prev = $prev }

name: Disable memory compression (16 GB+ RAM)
desc: Saves CPU cycles spent compressing RAM. Only helps if you have plenty of memory.
apply_text: Disable-MMAgent -MemoryCompression -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; $null

name: Disable Prefetch and SysMain (SSD only)
desc: Superfetch preloads apps into RAM, pointless on fast SSDs and a source of background disk activity.

name: Disable Windows Search indexing
desc: Stops the indexer. Start-menu and Explorer searches become slower but background disk/CPU use drops.

name: CPU: no core parking, always full speed (plugged in)
desc: Min processor state 100% and all cores unparked on AC power. Lowest latency; higher idle power and heat.

name: No USB selective suspend / PCIe link power saving
desc: Prevents devices and GPU links from sleeping mid-use: fixes USB stutter/disconnects and PCIe latency spikes.

name: Low-latency timer (disable dynamic tick)
desc: bcdedit disabledynamictick=yes and removes forced platform clock. Lower input latency; slightly higher idle power.
apply_text: $a = bcdedit /enum '{current}' | Out-String; bcdedit /set disabledynamictick yes | Out-Null; bcdedit /deletevalue useplatformclock 2>&1 | Out-Null; @{ HadPlatformClock = [bool]($a -match 'useplatformclock\s+Yes') }

name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
desc: Lets the GPU manage its own VRAM scheduling. Lower latency on modern NVIDIA/AMD GPUs (needs recent drivers).

name: Disable Memory Integrity (VBS/HVCI)
desc: WARNING: lowers kernel security. Can give 5-10% FPS in some games. Only for dedicated gaming rigs.

name: Honor per-app timer resolution requests
desc: GlobalTimerResolutionRequests = 1 (Windows 11 / Server 2022 behaviour restored): games and tools that request a 0.5 ms timer apply it system-wide again. Slightly higher idle power.

name: Disable app pre-launch and page combining
desc: Turns off MMAgent ApplicationPreLaunch and PageCombining: less background memory and disk activity. Apps may start marginally slower the first time.

name: Enable Game Mode
desc: Prioritizes the running game and suppresses driver/Windows-Update interruptions.

name: Disable Game DVR and background capture
desc: Stops Xbox Game Bar background recording, including the saved-clip, microphone and cursor captures. Game Bar overlay shortcuts stop working. It also sets the machine policy AllowGameDVR=0, which turns Game DVR off for every user and can disable other Windows game-capture features; undo restores the previous values.

name: Disable fullscreen optimizations globally
desc: Forces true exclusive fullscreen behaviour. Helps some older titles; a few modern games prefer it on.

name: Disable Multiplane Overlay (MPO)
desc: Fixes stutter, flicker and black screens on some NVIDIA/AMD setups (multi-monitor, high refresh). Set OverlayTestMode = 5 in the DWM key; undo removes it.

name: Optimizations for windowed games
desc: Enables flip-model presentation for borderless/windowed DirectX 10/11 games: lower latency, VRR support. It replaces the whole DirectX user setting, so an existing Auto HDR choice (AutoHDREnable=1) is removed until you undo it.

name: Multimedia scheduler: favor games and remove network throttle
desc: MMCSS Games task gets high GPU/CPU priority and network throttling is lifted. Standard low-latency setup.

name: Disable mouse acceleration (enhance pointer precision)
desc: 1:1 mouse movement for consistent aim. Takes effect after sign-out.

name: Disable Sticky/Filter/Toggle Keys popups
desc: No more accessibility popup when you tap Shift five times in a game.

name: Disable Nagle algorithm (lower online-game latency)
desc: Sets TcpAckFrequency=1 and TCPNoDelay=1 on active interfaces so small packets are sent immediately.

name: Disable Teredo tunneling
desc: Removes an IPv6-over-IPv4 tunnel that adds latency and is rarely needed.
apply_text: netsh interface teredo set state disabled | Out-Null; $null

name: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
desc: Keeps IPv6 enabled but tries IPv4 first. Avoids slow connects on networks with broken IPv6.

name: Disable LLMNR name resolution
desc: Closes a spoofing-prone legacy name-resolution protocol. Regular DNS is unaffected.

name: Delivery Optimization: no peer-to-peer uploads
desc: Windows Update downloads only from Microsoft; your PC stops uploading updates to strangers.

name: Disable SMBv1 server
desc: Security hardening: SMBv1 is the protocol exploited by WannaCry.
apply_text: Set-SmbServerConfiguration -EnableSMB1Protocol $false -Force -Confirm:$false | Out-Null; $null

name: Disable telemetry and diagnostic data
desc: Sets telemetry to the minimum Windows allows, blocks device-name and dump uploads, stops DiagTrack and disables Microsoft data-collection tasks. Home and Pro still keep required diagnostics; this is the lowest setting those editions accept.

name: Disable activity history and timeline
desc: Stops Windows from recording and uploading your app/file activity. Clipboard history is unaffected.

name: Disable advertising ID and tailored ads
desc: Turns off the per-user advertising ID (also by policy) and tailored experiences based on diagnostic data.

name: Disable Start/lock-screen ads and suggested apps
desc: Stops consumer features, silent app installs, Start suggestions, tips and "finish setting up" nags.

name: Disable Bing web results in Start search
desc: Start search only searches your PC. Bing, Cortana and location-based web suggestions stay off, and nothing you type is sent out.

name: Disable Copilot, Recall and Click to Do
desc: Turns off the Windows AI features and the Copilot taskbar button via policy.

name: Disable location tracking
desc: Denies location for the machine and this account, turns off the location sensor and stops the Geolocation service. Maps and Find My Device will not work.

name: Disable typing, inking and speech data collection
desc: Stops Windows from harvesting what you type, ink and say to personalize services.

name: Disable feedback prompts and app-launch tracking
desc: No "How likely are you to recommend Windows" popups; Start stops tracking launched apps. The feedback timer is removed the same way Win11Debloat does, and undo puts it back.

name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
desc: Crash reports are no longer sent to Microsoft. Local crash dialogs remain.

name: Disable clipboard cloud sync
desc: Clipboard history stays local; nothing is synced to your Microsoft account.

name: Disable Remote Assistance
desc: Blocks inbound Remote Assistance invitations. Reduces attack surface.

name: Edge: disable nags, telemetry and background mode
desc: Edge policies: no startup boost, no background running, no shopping/rewards/recommendation clutter, no diagnostic data.

name: Remove Widgets and Chat taskbar buttons
desc: Hides Widgets and Teams Chat, blocks the news feed, stops Widgets preloading, and ends any Widgets process already running. The packages stay installed.
apply_text: Get-Process -Name 'Widgets','WidgetService','Win32Bridge.Server' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $null

name: Uninstall OneDrive
desc: Stops OneDrive, runs its per-user and per-machine uninstallers, blocks it from coming back (policy, update tasks, new-user setup entry), hides the Explorer sidebar entry and clears leftovers. Your files in the OneDrive folder are never deleted. Refuses to run while Desktop/Documents/Pictures are backed up into OneDrive: move them back first. Undo reinstalls it.

name: Services: set unneeded services to Manual
desc: Moves rarely-needed services (diagnostic collectors, peer networking, touch keyboard, and similar) to Manual. They still start if something asks.

name: Services: disable truly useless services
desc: Disables Fax, Remote Registry, Retail Demo, Internet Connection Sharing, the graphics performance monitor, SNMP trap, Maps broker, Media Player sharing and similar.

name: Disable Reserved Storage
desc: Gives back about 7 GB that Windows reserves for updates. Updates may fail on a nearly full disk.
apply_text: Dism.exe /Online /Set-ReservedStorageState /State:Disabled | Out-Null; $null

name: Show file extensions
desc: Always show .exe, .pdf, .zip... A basic security habit.

name: Show hidden files
desc: Show hidden files and folders in Explorer.

name: Open Explorer to This PC
desc: Instead of Home/Quick access.

name: Hide Home and Gallery in Explorer
desc: Removes the Home and Gallery entries from the navigation pane.

name: Classic right-click menu (Windows 11)
desc: Brings back the full context menu without "Show more options".
apply_text: New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32' -Force -Value '' | Out-Null; $null

name: Dark mode for apps and system
desc: Dark theme for Windows and apps.

name: Left-aligned taskbar
desc: Classic left taskbar alignment (Windows 11).

name: Hide taskbar search box
desc: Removes the search box from the taskbar (Win+S still works).

name: Hide Task View button
desc: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar.

name: End Task from taskbar right-click
desc: Adds "End task" to the taskbar app context menu.

name: Start menu: hide recommendations
desc: Hides the Recommended tips/shortcuts and account notifications in Start.

name: Num Lock on at startup
desc: Turn Num Lock on at sign-in.

name: Enable long file paths
desc: Lifts the 260-character path limit for apps that support it.

name: Disable lock screen
desc: Skips the lock screen picture and goes straight to sign-in.

name: Scrollbars always visible
desc: Stops scrollbars hiding automatically.

name: Verbose blue-screen details
desc: Shows technical parameters on BSOD for troubleshooting.

name: Disable Fault Tolerant Heap
desc: FTH applies slow-path mitigations to apps that crashed a few times and keeps them there. Resets its list and turns it off.
apply_text: rundll32.exe fthsvc.dll,FthSysprepSpecialize; Set-RegEntry 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\FTH' 'Enabled' 0 'DWord'; $null

name: Disable background apps
desc: Store apps no longer run in the background, including the Windows 11 policy that forces it off for every account. Less CPU, RAM and network use; notifications from those apps stop.

name: Disable SleepStudy and power diagnostic logging
desc: Turns off Modern Standby / power diagnostic event logs and the Power Efficiency Diagnostics task. Less background disk writes.
apply_text:
foreach ($l in 'Microsoft-Windows-SleepStudy/Diagnostic', 'Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Processor-Power/Diagnostic', 'Microsoft-Windows-UserModePowerService/Diagnostic') { wevtutil.exe set-log $l /e:false 2>&1 | Out-Null }
      $null

name: Keep kernel in RAM (16 GB+ only)
desc: DisablePagingExecutive + DisablePageCombining: kernel and drivers are never paged out. Snappier with plenty of RAM; wasteful on small machines.

name: Do not split service hosts (fewer svchost processes)
desc: Services share svchost processes again instead of one process each: roughly 50-70 fewer processes and a little less RAM. Xbox services are left alone.

name: NTFS: stop creating 8.3 short names
desc: No more DOS-style short names for new files: faster directory operations. Very old 16-bit installers may break.
apply_text: $o = Invoke-Native fsutil @('8dot3name', 'query'); $prev = if ($o -match '(?:state|value)[^0-9]*([0-3])') { [int]$Matches[1] } else { 2 }; fsutil 8dot3name set 1 | Out-Null; @{ Prev = $prev }

name: Explorer: stop auto-detecting folder types
desc: Every folder opens as a generic folder instead of Windows guessing "Pictures/Music" per folder, which is a classic cause of slow Explorer. Folder view memory is backed up and reset.
apply_text:
$stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
      $bags = Join-Path $OptiBackupDir "shellbags-$stamp.reg"
      $mru  = Join-Path $OptiBackupDir "shellbagmru-$stamp.reg"
      reg.exe export 'HKCU\SOFTWARE\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags' $bags /y 2>&1 | Out-Null
      reg.exe export 'HKCU\SOFTWARE\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\BagMRU' $mru /y 2>&1 | Out-Null
      Remove-Item "$global:SHELLBAGS\Bags", "$global:SHELLBAGS\BagMRU" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      Set-RegEntry "$global:SHELLBAGS\Bags\AllFolders\Shell" 'FolderType' 'NotSpecified' 'String'
      @{ Bags = $bags; Mru = $mru }

name: Automatic Maintenance: never wake the PC
desc: Scheduled maintenance still runs when the PC is on, but it can no longer wake it from sleep at night.

name: Bigger icon cache (4 MB)
desc: Explorer keeps more icons in memory, so big folders redraw faster.

name: Instant hover tooltips
desc: Mouse hover delay for tooltips and file info drops from 400 ms to 20 ms.

name: Block WPBT (firmware-injected programs)
desc: Stops firmware from dropping and running OEM software on every boot (the Windows Platform Binary Table). Also a security hardening.

name: Force-close apps on shutdown and sign-out
desc: Apps are closed immediately without the "save changes?" wait. Faster, but unsaved work is lost.

name: Disable Aero Shake
desc: Shaking a window no longer minimizes all the others (usually triggered by accident).

name: SMB: remove bandwidth throttling
desc: Network share transfers are no longer rate-limited by the client. Helps on fast LANs and NAS copies.

name: Opt out of Microsoft experiments
desc: Stops Microsoft from using your PC as a test subject for unfinished features.

name: Disable Program Compatibility Assistant
desc: No more "this program might not have installed correctly" popups and app-usage reporting.

name: Disable responsiveness tracking
desc: Stops Windows from collecting and reporting app responsiveness events (Windows Diagnostic Infrastructure).

name: Disable most-used-apps tracking
desc: Start no longer builds a "most used" list from what you launch.

name: Disable RSoP policy logging
desc: Stops logging of resultant-set-of-policy data after every Group Policy refresh.

name: Disable device health attestation reporting
desc: Stops device-health reporting to Microsoft at startup.

name: Disable Customer Experience Improvement Program
desc: Turns off CEIP / SQM data collection for Windows and App-V.

name: Disable diagnostic tracing
desc: Turns off Windows performance diagnostic tracing sessions.

name: Opt out of .NET CLI telemetry
desc: Sets DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 system-wide for developers using dotnet.

name: Skip post-update privacy re-prompt
desc: Feature updates will not show the privacy-settings screen that can reset your choices.

name: Disable Shared Experiences and Cross Device Resume
desc: No nearby sharing, no continuing apps from other devices.

name: Stop Malicious Software Removal Tool reporting
desc: MSRT still removes malware but stops sending infection reports.

name: Windows Update: no forced restarts while signed in
desc: Sets the NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers policy so scheduled update restarts wait until you sign out. Updates still install. It is not a guarantee: Windows can still show restart reminders and restart after its deadlines.

name: Block Windows Insider enrollment
desc: Prevents accidental enrollment in preview builds that can undo tweaks and cause instability.

name: No "- Shortcut" suffix on new shortcuts
desc: New shortcuts are named like the target.

name: Show more details in file copy dialogs
desc: Copy/move dialogs open expanded with the speed graph.

name: Compact Explorer spacing
desc: Tighter rows in Explorer lists (the Windows 10 density).

name: Disable low disk space warnings
desc: No balloon when a drive is nearly full.

name: Disable autocorrect and text prediction
desc: Turns off touch-keyboard autocorrect, spell check, suggestions and double-tap-space.

name: Disable touch visual feedback
desc: No ripple circles on touch screens.

name: Do not lower sounds during calls
desc: Windows stops muting other audio when it detects communication activity.

name: Verbose startup, shutdown and sign-in messages
desc: Shows what Windows is doing instead of "Please wait".

name: Turn off Recall and AI data analysis
desc: Policy blocks Recall snapshots and AI data analysis for you and the machine; the Recall Windows feature is switched off where it exists (Copilot+ PCs).
apply_text:
$f = Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Recall -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      if ($f -and $f.State -eq 'Enabled') { Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Recall -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; @{ WasEnabled = $true } } else { @{ WasEnabled = $false } }

name: Turn off Click to Do and AI search suggestions
desc: Disables the Click to Do overlay and dynamic search-box highlights in the taskbar.

name: Hide Copilot button and block Copilot policy
desc: Removes the Copilot taskbar button and sets the TurnOffWindowsCopilot policy for the user and the machine.

name: Notepad, Paint and Photos: turn off AI features
desc: Group-policy switches that hide Notepad AI (Rewrite/Summarize), Paint Cocreator, Generative Fill and Image Creator. Which switches apply depends on the app version.

name: Edge: turn off Copilot sidebar and page context
desc: Edge policies: hides the sidebar/Copilot hub, stops Copilot reading page content, hides the Microsoft 365 Copilot icon.

name: Search: no cloud account content or search highlights
desc: Stops Windows Search from querying your Microsoft/work account cloud content and removes the daily search highlights (doodles, trending topics) from the search box.

name: No tailored experiences from your diagnostic data
desc: Windows stops using your diagnostic data to personalize tips, ads and recommendations.

name: Uninstall the Copilot and AI app packages
desc: Removes every installed Copilot / AI Hub package, the Microsoft 365 (Office hub) Copilot launcher and the Store Copilot for all users and from the provisioning list so new accounts do not get them. Also removes the Windows AI core package using the same end-of-life method WinUtil uses. Undo cannot reinstall: use the Microsoft Store.

name: Hide the Settings "AI components" page
desc: Hides Settings > System > AI components (Windows 11 24H2+), as WinUtil does. Other pages you hid with this policy are kept.

name: Turn off Windows Spotlight and lock-screen promos
desc: No Spotlight desktop icon or lock-screen "fun facts", tips and promoted content.

name: Stop Teams (Chat) from auto-installing
desc: Prevents Windows from silently installing the consumer Teams app on new sessions and updates.

name: Block forced Outlook and Dev Home installs
desc: Deletes the Windows Update orchestrator entries that reinstall the new Outlook and Dev Home after feature updates.
apply_text:
$base = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\Orchestrator\UScheduler_Oobe'
      $gone = @()
      foreach ($n in 'OutlookUpdate', 'DevHomeUpdate') { if (Test-Path "$base\$n") { Remove-Item "$base\$n" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $gone += $n } }
      , $gone

name: Microsoft Store: no promoted apps or auto-updates of consumer apps
desc: Stops the Store from pushing suggested apps and turns off automatic app updates (you can still update manually).

name: Turn off news, weather and interests feeds
desc: Removes the news-and-interests feed from the taskbar and the Widgets news board via policy.

name: Start menu: hide the Recommended section
desc: Removes "Recommended" (recent files and suggested apps) from the Windows 11 Start menu using the user and machine policies plus the Pro-edition override WinUtil uses. Side effect (WinUtil warns the same): Windows Spotlight on the lock screen stops.

name: Uninstall Microsoft Edge
desc: Uses the method WinUtil uses: a placeholder legacy Edge file unlocks Edge's own system-level uninstaller, with its profile data deleted. WebView2 (needed by many apps) stays. Windows Update can bring Edge back. Undo reinstalls it through WinGet.
apply_text:
$setup = @(Get-ChildItem -Path "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft\Edge\Application\*\Installer\setup.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 1)
      if (-not $setup.Count) { Write-Log '  Edge is not installed' ; return $null }
      Stop-Process -Name 'msedge' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      New-Item -Path "$env:SystemRoot\SystemApps\Microsoft.MicrosoftEdge_8wekyb3d8bbwe\MicrosoftEdge.exe" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
      $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $setup[0].FullName -ArgumentList '--uninstall --system-level --force-uninstall --delete-profile' -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      if ($proc -and -not $proc.WaitForExit(240000)) { Write-Log '  Edge uninstaller still running after 4 minutes' 'WARN' }
      $null

name: Hardware clock in UTC (dual boot with Linux)
desc: Windows keeps the hardware clock in UTC like Linux does, so the time stays right when you dual boot (WinUtil).

name: Detailed blue-screen information
desc: Shows the stop code and parameters on a blue screen instead of the smiley face (WinUtil).

name: Show battery percentage in the system tray
desc: Adds the numeric percentage next to the battery icon (WinUtil).

name: Sharp sign-in screen background (no acrylic blur)
desc: Turns off the blur on the sign-in screen background (WinUtil).

name: Turn off window snapping
desc: Windows stop snapping and resizing when dragged to screen edges (Win11Debloat / WinUtil).

name: Block Razer software auto-install
desc: Stops Windows from silently installing Razer Synapse when a Razer device is plugged in, by locking the Razer installer folder (WinUtil). The hardware keeps working. Undo unlocks the folder.

name: Block Logitech Download Assistant auto-install
desc: Stops Windows Update from reinstalling the Logi Download Assistant with Logitech drivers, by locking its folder (WinUtil). Logitech hardware keeps working. Undo unlocks the folder.

name: Chrome: no telemetry, background mode or promos
desc: Turns off usage metrics, background running, startup boost, default-browser nags, shopping and promo tabs, feedback surveys and Privacy Sandbox ad topics. Applied as browser policy, so the browser shows "managed by your organization". Undo removes it.

name: Chrome: turn off Gemini and generative AI features
desc: Disables Gemini integration, Help me write, tab organizer, AI themes, tab compare and the AI-mode omnibox entry. Applied as browser policy, so the browser shows "managed by your organization". Undo removes it.

name: Brave: remove Rewards, Wallet, VPN, News, Talk and AI Chat
desc: Hides the crypto, ads, VPN, news, Talk and Leo features and turns off metrics, stats ping, web discovery and background mode. Applied as browser policy, so the browser shows "managed by your organization". Undo removes it.

name: Edge: remove new-tab feed, workspaces, Bing ads and promos
desc: Extra Edge policies on top of "Edge: disable nags": new-tab news feed, promotional tabs, workspaces, Bing ads, default-browser nag, Do Not Track, metrics, and the Microsoft Editor sidebar extension WinUtil blocks. Applied as browser policy, so the browser shows "managed by your organization". Undo removes it.

name: Firefox: no telemetry, studies, Pocket, sponsored content or nags
desc: Disables telemetry, Shield studies, Pocket, sponsored top sites and suggestions, the default-browser agent, feedback commands, whats-new pages and extension/feature recommendations. Applied as browser policy, so the browser shows "managed by your organization". Undo removes it.

name: Firefox: turn off AI chatbot, link previews and AI tab groups
desc: Sets the GenerativeAI policy so the sidebar chatbot, AI link previews and AI tab-group suggestions are off (Firefox 139 and newer). Applied as browser policy, so the browser shows "managed by your organization". Undo removes it.

name: Vivaldi: no metrics or background mode
desc: Vivaldi honors Chromium policies: turns off metrics and background running. Applied as browser policy, so the browser shows "managed by your organization". Undo removes it.

name: Browser updater services: set to Manual
desc: Google Update and Brave Update services stop running constantly and start on demand. Browsers still update through their scheduled tasks.

name: Opera / Opera GX: stop autostart and background auto-update tasks
desc: Disables the "Opera Browser Assistant" startup entries and the "Opera scheduled Autoupdate" tasks, so Opera no longer launches helpers at sign-in. Opera still updates when you open it. Opera has no policy support, so its AI (Aria), GX Corner, wallet and sidebar toggles can only be changed inside Opera settings.

name: Remove "Share" from the right-click menu
desc: Removes the ModernSharing context-menu handler. The deleted key is exported first; undo re-imports it.
apply_text: Remove-RegKeysWithBackup @('HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\*\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers\ModernSharing') 'ctx-share'

name: Remove "Give access to" from the right-click menu
desc: Removes the network-sharing "Give access to" handlers from files, folders and drives. Backed up and reversible.
apply_text:
Remove-RegKeysWithBackup @(
          'HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\*\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers\Sharing'
          'HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\Directory\Background\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers\Sharing'
          'HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\Directory\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers\Sharing'
          'HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\Drive\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers\Sharing'
          'HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\LibraryFolder\background\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers\Sharing'
          'HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\UserLibraryFolder\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers\Sharing') 'ctx-giveaccess'

name: Remove "Include in library" from the right-click menu
desc: Removes the Library Location handler from folders. Backed up and reversible.
apply_text: Remove-RegKeysWithBackup @('HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\Folder\ShellEx\ContextMenuHandlers\Library Location', 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Classes\Folder\ShellEx\ContextMenuHandlers\Library Location') 'ctx-library'

name: This PC: hide 3D Objects, Music and duplicate removable drives
desc: Removes those entries from the This PC / navigation pane. Backed up and reversible.
apply_text:
Remove-RegKeysWithBackup @(
          'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\MyComputer\NameSpace\{0DB7E03F-FC29-4DC6-9020-FF41B59E513A}'
          'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\MyComputer\NameSpace\{0DB7E03F-FC29-4DC6-9020-FF41B59E513A}'
          'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\MyComputer\NameSpace\{3dfdf296-dbec-4fb4-81d1-6a3438bcf4de}'
          'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\MyComputer\NameSpace\{3dfdf296-dbec-4fb4-81d1-6a3438bcf4de}'
          'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Desktop\NameSpace\DelegateFolders\{F5FB2C77-0E2F-4A16-A381-3E560C68BC83}') 'thispc'

name: Hide OneDrive in the Explorer navigation pane
desc: Takes the OneDrive entry out of the Explorer sidebar without uninstalling OneDrive.

name: Do not track recent and frequent files in Explorer
desc: Quick access stops showing recent files and frequent folders.

name: Alt+Tab: windows only, no Edge tabs
desc: Alt+Tab lists windows, not individual browser tabs.

name: Taskbar: clicking a grouped app re-opens its last window
desc: Single click on a grouped taskbar icon focuses the last active window instead of showing previews.

name: Turn off all toast notifications
desc: No notification popups from any app (you can still open the notification center). Re-enable in Settings > Notifications.

name: Hide the Settings home page
desc: Settings opens on System instead of the Home page with cloud and account promos.

name: Disable the Share drag tray
desc: Stops the "drag files here to share" tray that appears when dragging files to the top of the screen.

name: Hide Phone Link in the Start menu
desc: Removes the Phone Link companion panel from Start.

name: Classic boot menu (F8 advanced options)
desc: bcdedit bootmenupolicy legacy: F8 works at boot for Safe Mode. Undo sets it back to standard.
apply_text: bcdedit /set '{default}' bootmenupolicy legacy | Out-Null; $null

name: Disable device search history
desc: Windows stops remembering what you search for on this device.

name: Disable online speech recognition
desc: Voice data is no longer sent to Microsoft for cloud speech recognition.

name: Disable Find My Device
desc: Stops location reporting for Find My Device. You lose the ability to locate this PC from your Microsoft account.

name: Block anonymous enumeration of accounts and shares
desc: Security hardening: anonymous users can no longer list accounts or share names.

name: Do not auto-download device apps from manufacturers
desc: Windows stops fetching vendor companion apps and icons when you plug in hardware.

name: Remove Microsoft 365 and account promos from Settings
desc: Hides the consumer account-state banners and offers in the Settings app.

name: Turn off remaining Windows suggestions and nag toasts
desc: The rest of the Win11Debloat suggestions list: Start tips, account notifications, OneDrive ads, backup reminders, suggested toasts and Phone Link nags.

name: AI Fabric service: start on demand only
desc: Sets the Windows AI Fabric service (WSAIFabricSvc) to Manual so it does not start with Windows.

name: Windows Update: do not get new features as soon as available
desc: Turns off "Get the latest updates as soon as they are available" so feature rollouts reach you later, after they have settled.

name: Prevent automatic BitLocker device encryption
desc: Stops Windows from silently encrypting the drive at first sign-in with a Microsoft account. Already-encrypted drives are not decrypted.

name: Turn off Storage Sense
desc: Windows stops auto-deleting temp files and Recycle Bin items on a schedule. Use the Cleaner tab instead.

name: Disable network in Modern Standby
desc: No network activity while the PC is in Modern Standby (S0): less battery drain and fewer random wake-ups. Notifications arrive when you wake it.

name: Lossless desktop wallpaper quality
desc: Windows recompresses wallpapers to ~85% JPEG quality; this keeps 100%. Re-apply your wallpaper afterwards.

name: Stop Windows controlling RGB lighting
desc: Turns off Windows Dynamic Lighting so vendor RGB software (Razer, Corsair, ASUS...) is not overridden.

name: Disable USB error and weak-charger notifications
desc: No balloon when a USB device malfunctions or charges slowly.

name: Full right-click menu on more than 15 selected items
desc: Windows stops hiding menu entries when you right-click a large selection.

name: No cloud/Office files in Quick access
desc: Quick access stops listing recent Office/cloud documents.

name: Disable AutoPlay for drives and devices
desc: Inserting a USB stick or card no longer pops up AutoPlay. Also a malware-spreading vector closed.

name: No "Public or Private network?" prompt
desc: New networks are classified automatically without the location wizard popup.
apply_text: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Network\NewNetworkWindowOff' -Force | Out-Null; $null

name: Disable Ease of Access auto-read and shortcut launcher
desc: Stops "always read and scan this section" and the Win+U-style assistive tool launch on touch/pen.

name: Print Screen does not open Snipping Tool
desc: Frees the Print Screen key for other screenshot tools (it copies the screen as before).

name: Do not search for missing shortcut targets
desc: Windows stops hunting the whole disk when a shortcut is broken, which can freeze Explorer for seconds.

name: Do not look up apps online for unknown file types
desc: Opening an unknown file no longer queries Microsoft for "Look for an app in the Store".

name: Network adapters: never power down to save energy
desc: Disables "Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power" on physical network adapters: fewer dropouts and wake-up lag. Previous settings are saved.

name: Restrict anonymous (null session) access to shares
desc: Security hardening: anonymous connections can no longer reach named pipes and shares.

name: Disable online tips in Settings
desc: Settings stops fetching tips and "did you know" banners from Microsoft.

name: Disable camera on the lock screen
desc: Swiping on the lock screen can no longer open the camera.

name: Stop automatic speech-model downloads
desc: Windows no longer downloads speech data updates in the background.

name: Disable settings sync to your Microsoft account
desc: Themes, passwords-metadata and preferences are no longer synced across your devices.

name: Disable message cloud sync
desc: Blocks SMS/message sync to the cloud.

name: NVIDIA: opt out of telemetry
desc: Turns off NVIDIA Control Panel usage telemetry and the NVIDIA telemetry container service (if installed).

name: Microsoft Office: opt out of telemetry and feedback
desc: User policies that disable Office customer-data upload, telemetry, feedback, screenshots and the Office logging service.

name: Do not auto-archive Store apps
desc: Windows stops silently "archiving" (unloading) apps you have not used for a while.

name: Windows Update: remove "update and shut down" nag
desc: The power menu defaults to plain Shut down and the "Get the latest updates" link is hidden.

name: Windows Update: security updates first, delay feature updates 1 year
desc: Quality (security) updates arrive after 4 days; feature updates (24H2, 25H2...) are held back for 365 days so new builds settle first. Updates are never disabled.

name: Windows Update: do not install drivers automatically
desc: Windows Update stops swapping your GPU/chipset drivers for its own versions. Install drivers from the vendor instead.

name: Windows Update: pause all updates for 35 days
desc: Uses the same pause Settings offers (maximum 35 days). Updates resume automatically afterwards. Undo resumes immediately.

name: Block Windows telemetry and ad servers in the hosts file
desc: Downloads the WindowsSpyBlocker "spy" list (MIT, github.com/crazy-max/WindowsSpyBlocker), drops entries that would break developer tooling, and adds the rest to your hosts file between marker lines. The file is backed up first and undo removes only that block. Windows Defender may flag hosts-file edits that block Microsoft domains.
apply_text:
$hosts = "$env:SystemRoot\System32\drivers\etc\hosts"
      [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
      $raw = (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crazy-max/WindowsSpyBlocker/master/data/hosts/spy.txt' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 25 -ErrorAction Stop).Content
      $entries = @($raw -split "`n" | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\s*0\.0\.0\.0\s+([a-z0-9][a-z0-9\.\-]+)\s*$') { $Matches[1] } } |
                   Where-Object { $_ -notmatch 'blob\.core\.windows\.net$|visualstudio|nuget|dotnet' } | Sort-Object -Unique)
      if ($entries.Count -lt 50) { throw "blocklist looked wrong ($($entries.Count) entries), hosts file left untouched" }
      $backup = Join-Path $OptiBackupDir ('hosts-{0}.bak' -f (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'))
      Copy-Item -LiteralPath $hosts -Destination $backup -Force
      Add-HostsBlock -Path $hosts -Entries $entries
      ipconfig /flushdns | Out-Null
      @{ Backup = $backup; Count = $entries.Count }

name: Unhide "Loudness Equalization" on audio devices
desc: Some audio drivers hide the Loudness Equalization checkbox (Sound > device Properties > Enhancements). Adds the FxProperties value that unhides it on every render endpoint; restarts the audio service. You still enable the checkbox yourself.

name: Stop Game Bar popups when a game or controller opens
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: points the ms-gamebar and ms-gamebarservices links at systray so Windows stops opening Game Bar when a game launches or a controller connects. Your previous registration is exported first.

name: No app suggestions when snapping windows
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: turns off Snap Assist, the row of other windows offered after you snap one to a side or corner.

name: Hide snap layout flyouts
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: hides the snap layout popup on the maximize button and when a window is dragged to the top of the screen. Snapping itself stays on.

name: Taskbar: never combine buttons, show labels
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: the main taskbar keeps a separate button and a label for every window.

name: Taskbar: combine buttons only when full
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: the main taskbar shows labels until it runs out of room, then combines them.

name: Secondary taskbars: never combine buttons
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: taskbars on extra monitors show a separate labeled button for every window.

name: Extra monitors: show a window on the main taskbar too
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: an app appears on the main taskbar and on the monitor where its window is open.

name: Extra monitors: show a window only where it is open
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: each window is listed only on the taskbar of the monitor it sits on.

name: Open Explorer to Downloads
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: File Explorer starts in Downloads instead of Home or This PC.

name: Show drive letters before the drive name
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: Explorer lists "C: Local Disk" instead of "Local Disk (C:)".

name: Show network drive letters before the name
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: only network drives put the letter first. Local drives stay "name (letter)". Replaces the all-drives letter layout if that was applied.

name: Hide drive letters
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: Explorer shows drive names without letters. Undo restores the previous layout.

name: Hide "Learn about this picture" on the desktop
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: hides the Spotlight desktop shortcut. Rotating Spotlight wallpaper can stay on. This does not turn Spotlight off.

name: This PC: show Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures and Videos
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: puts those folders back on the This PC page. Previous hide flags are saved and restored on undo.

name: Start All apps: grid
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat (Windows 11 25H2, build 26200 and newer): the All apps list uses the alphabetical grid.

name: Start All apps: list
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat (Windows 11 25H2, build 26200 and newer): the All apps list uses the alphabetical list. Category view is the Windows default; undo restores whatever you had.

name: Hide All apps in Start
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat (build 26200 and newer): removes the All apps section from Start. Installed apps are harder to find. Undo restores the section.

name: Taskbar search: icon only
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: replaces the search box with a search icon. Win+S still opens search.

name: Taskbar search: icon and label
desc: Adapted from Win11Debloat: shows a search icon with the word Search, narrower than the full box.

name: Disable the notification center and calendar flyout
desc: Adapted from Chris Titus Tech WinUtil: turns off the notification center, including the calendar flyout. Toast popups are a separate tweak.

name: Hide Microsoft Store suggestions in search
desc: Adapted from Chris Titus Tech WinUtil: denies Everyone write access to the Store recommendation database so Start search stops offering Store apps. Undo removes only that deny entry. Needs the Microsoft Store package for this account.

name: Prefer classic S3 sleep over Modern Standby
desc: Adapted from Chris Titus Tech WinUtil: sets PlatformAoAcOverride so the PC uses S3 sleep (CPU powered off, memory refreshed) instead of Modern Standby. Some laptops sleep poorly or not at all with this. Undo restores the previous value.

name: Do not warn when opening an unsigned Remote Desktop file
desc: Adapted from Chris Titus Tech WinUtil: skips the warning added by recent Windows 10 and 11 updates when you open an .rdp file that is not signed. Leave this off unless you open Remote Desktop files you trust.

name: Prefer the Start menu layout from before the 25H2 rollout
desc: Adapted from Chris Titus Tech WinUtil: sets the feature override that keeps the previous Start layout on builds still honoring it. WinUtil warns this does nothing on newer Windows. Undo restores the previous override value.

name: NTFS: larger file-system cache pool (16 GB+ RAM)
desc: NtfsMemoryUsage = 2 lets NTFS keep more metadata in non-paged memory. Faster file listing and builds on busy drives; costs a little RAM.

name: NTFS: bigger MFT zone on hard disks
desc: NtfsMftZoneReservation = 2 reserves 25% of the volume for the file table so it fragments less. Helps HDDs with many small files; ignored on SSDs.

name: Make sure TRIM is enabled (SSD)
desc: Windows normally enables TRIM on SSDs; this turns it back on if a tool or driver switched it off. Keeps write speed up over time.
apply_text: $o = Invoke-Native fsutil @('behavior', 'query', 'DisableDeleteNotify'); $prev = if ($o -match 'NTFS\s+DisableDeleteNotify\s*=\s*(\d)') { [int]$Matches[1] } else { 0 }; fsutil behavior set DisableDeleteNotify 0 | Out-Null; @{ Prev = $prev }
